**2 — Vessel:** A square dinner plate, approximately 26 cm across. Using a roughly 26 cm equivalent circular diameter gives an estimated usable area of **3.14 × 13² = 531 cm²**.

**3 — Items:** Red grapes, cantaloupe pieces, roasted skin-on potatoes, and some orange roasted pieces that appear to be sweet potato. A light oily coating appears present on the roasted vegetables; it is included in their energy density rather than counted separately. No distinct sauce is visible.
